verdict.rationale: Jina Reader is fundamentally an HTTP API (r.jina.ai, s.jina.ai) with extensive documented headers/parameters (x-respond-with, x-preset, x-engine, x-json-schema, x-instruction, x-markdown-chunking, etc.) enabling rich programmatic control, plus an official MCP server for agentic integration. Minor caveats: no discoverable OpenAPI spec/llms.txt and one community report of auth errors, but core API is well documented and clearly designed for LLM/agent consumption.
